definition.purpose: Close the optimized code-generation and ARC reentrancy boundary for E01 using three existing tests; preserve accepted Debug functional evidence.

definition.acceptance: Exactly three requested tests discovered and executed once, all pass with zero failures/skips/missing/extras; unchanged production/test source identities; no SDK-caused crash/deadlock; cleanup and protected checkout unchanged.
definition.preflight: Rediscover MCP workspace and available simulator, verify source hashes/HEAD/signature and no competing host build; no credentials or Datadog upload required.
definition.optimization: Verify actual DatadogInternal and selected test compile commands use -O plus -enable-testing or equivalent generated artifacts. Never substitute a Debug pass.
definition.bound: One build/test attempt for the three fixed selectors,1800second process limit. A setup failure or assertion failure stops execution and requires recorded diagnosis before retry.
